title: Rusija pažljivo pratila izbore u SAD-u
Russia followed the US elections closely
body: Rusija je pažljivo pratila izbore u SAD-u, a sada se pitaju hoće li rezultati ograničiti Trumpov pristup Moskvi.
Russia followed the US elections closely, and now people ask whether the results will limit Trump's approach to Moscow.
Republikanci su izgubili većinu, pa bi demokrate u januaru mogle preuzeti Kongres.
The Republicans lost their majority, so the Democrats could take over Congress in January.
Kremlj ipak očekuje da će Trump nastaviti svoje mirovne napore.
The Kremlin still expects that Trump will continue his peace efforts.
Glasnogovornik Dmitrij Peskov rekao je da već postoje temelji za razgovore.
Spokesman Dmitry Peskov said that foundations for talks already exist.
Nova runda pregovora Rusije, Ukrajine i SAD-a trebala bi uskoro biti u Abu Dabiju.
A new round of talks between Russia, Ukraine and the USA should take place soon in Abu Dhabi.
Prošlog mjeseca Trump je dozvolio uvoz dizela iz Rusije i privremeno zaustavio nove sankcije.
Last month Trump allowed diesel imports from Russia and temporarily stopped new sanctions.
To je naljutilo Kijev i evropske saveznike.
This angered Kyiv and European allies.
Ukrajina traži brže isporuke projektila Patriot, a SAD su 30. oktobra odobrile prodaju vrijednu 2,1 milijardu dolara.
Ukraine wants faster deliveries of Patriot missiles, and on 30 October the USA approved a sale worth 2.1 billion dollars.
Medvedev smatra da Trumpu nije potreban dodatni sukob s demokratama.
Medvedev thinks Trump does not need an extra conflict with the Democrats.
Zelenski je rekao da bi rezultat mogao povećati šanse za dodatnu pomoć.
Zelensky said the result could increase the chances of extra aid.
Analitičari upozoravaju da Kongres može pojačati pritisak, ali predsjednik i dalje ima velika ovlaštenja u vanjskoj politici.
Analysts warn that Congress can increase pressure, but the president still has broad powers in foreign policy.

title: Je li Trump ponudio posao pogrešnom Dani Whiteu?
Did Trump offer a job to the wrong Dana White?
body: Na internetu se širi teorija da je Donald Trump ponudio posao pogrešnoj osobi.
A theory is spreading online that Donald Trump offered a job to the wrong person.
U subotu je na mreži Truth Social pozvao Danu Whitea, šefa UFC-a, da postane glasnogovornik Bijele kuće.
On Saturday he invited Dana White, the head of the UFC, on Truth Social to become the White House press secretary.
Zamolio ga je da dovede šest boraca kao pomoćnike, među njima Khabiba Nurmagomedova i Islama Makhacheva.
He asked him to bring six fighters as assistants, among them Khabib Nurmagomedov and Islam Makhachev.
Novinar Adam Cochran napisao je da je na užoj listi bila Dana W. White, bivša glasnogovornica Pentagona.
Journalist Adam Cochran wrote that Dana W. White, a former Pentagon spokesperson, was on the shortlist.
Prema njemu, Trump je objavio ime šefa UFC-a, a da ta Dana nije ni znala.
According to him, Trump announced the name of the UFC head without that Dana even knowing.
Njegovu objavu vidjelo je više od 300.000 ljudi.
More than 300,000 people saw his post.
Dana W. White radila je u Pentagonu od aprila 2017. do kraja 2018.
Dana W. White worked at the Pentagon from April 2017 to the end of 2018.
Neki korisnici sumnjaju u teoriju, jer Trump opisuje borca i traži borce UFC-a.
Some users doubt the theory, because Trump describes a fighter and asks for UFC fighters.
Bijela kuća nije potvrdila nijednu verziju.
The White House has not confirmed either version.
Dana White rekao je na konferenciji u Londonu da odmah putuje u Washington.
Dana White said at a press conference in London that he is flying to Washington immediately.
U ponedjeljak imaju sastanak, a poslije njega će reći više.
They have a meeting on Monday, and after it he will say more.
Mjesto glasnogovornika prazno je od sredine oktobra, kada je Katie Zacharia otišla poslije samo pet dana.
The press secretary post has been empty since mid-October, when Katie Zacharia left after only five days.

title: Aurus snizio cijenu Putinove limuzine Senat
Aurus cut the price of Putin's Senat limousine
body: Ruski proizvođač Aurus znatno je snizio cijenu limuzine Senat, koju koristi Vladimir Putin.
The Russian maker Aurus has sharply cut the price of the Senat limousine, which Vladimir Putin uses.
Cijena je pala sa 50 na 40 miliona rubalja, odnosno sa oko 550.000 na 440.000 eura.
The price fell from 50 to 40 million rubles, that is, from about 550,000 to 440,000 euros.
Kompanija tako pokušava dostići planiranu prodaju.
In this way the company is trying to reach its planned sales.
Projekt je počeo 2013., a razvoj je koštao 12,4 milijarde rubalja.
The project started in 2013, and development cost 12.4 billion rubles.
Serijska proizvodnja počela je u maju 2021. u Jelabugi, s planom od 5.000 vozila godišnje.
Serial production started in May 2021 in Yelabuga, with a plan of 5,000 vehicles a year.
Iako se auto predstavlja kao domaći, za njega su dugo korišteni dijelovi iz Južne Koreje, Kine, Indije, Turske i EU.
Although the car is presented as domestic, parts from South Korea, China, India, Turkey and the EU were used for it for a long time.
Zbog visoke cijene interes kupaca bio je gotovo nikakav.
Because of the high price, buyer interest was almost nonexistent.
U 2025. je u Jelabugi sastavljeno manje od 150 vozila.
In 2025 fewer than 150 vehicles were assembled in Yelabuga.
Izvori upozoravaju da bi tvornica u Jelabugi mogla biti zatvorena do kraja godine.
Sources warn that the factory in Yelabuga could close by the end of the year.
Radnicima su ponudili preseljenje u Sankt Peterburg, gdje se planira model Aurus 900 po cijeni od 12 miliona rubalja.
Workers were offered relocation to Saint Petersburg, where the Aurus 900 model is planned at a price of 12 million rubles.
Prema ruskim izvorima, Putin će i dalje dobijati nove limuzine.
According to Russian sources, Putin will still get new limousines.

title: Američka aktivistica navodno naplaćivala objave, među njima i podršku Dodiku
US activist allegedly charged for posts, including support for Dodik
body: Američka desničarka Laura Loomer, bliska saveznica Donalda Trumpa, navodno je naplaćivala političke objave na društvenim mrežama.
US right-wing activist Laura Loomer, a close ally of Donald Trump, allegedly charged money for political posts on social media.
Piše to Washington Post, a među spornim porukama je i ona u prilog Miloradu Dodiku.
The Washington Post writes this, and among the disputed messages is one in support of Milorad Dodik.
Novinari su razgovarali s četiri osobe, među njima i Alexom Bruesewitzom, savjetnikom Trumpove kampanje.
Reporters spoke with four people, among them Alex Bruesewitz, an adviser to Trump's campaign.
Prema dokumentima, Loomer i njena firma od maja 2025. primili su četiri uplate, ukupno više od 60.000 dolara.
According to documents, Loomer and her firm have received four payments since May 2025, over 60,000 dollars in total.
Dokumenti ne kažu čemu je novac služio.
The documents do not say what the money was for.
Dva izvora tvrde da je tražila od 3.000 do 5.000 dolara po objavi.
Two sources claim she asked for 3,000 to 5,000 dollars per post.
Bruesewitz kaže da joj je plaćao objave, a sada je to javno rekao jer je, kako misli, praksa otišla predaleko.
Bruesewitz says he paid her for posts, and he has now said it publicly because, in his view, the practice went too far.
Loomer sve negira i tvrdi da je plaćen samo jedan istraživački dokument.
Loomer denies everything and claims that only one research document was paid for.
Loomer je 23. oktobra 2025. na mreži X branila Dodika od napada.
On 23 October 2025 Loomer defended Dodik from attacks on the network X.
Demokrate u Kongresu navele su je u izvještaju među osobama koje su djelovale u Dodikovu korist.
Democrats in Congress named her in a report among people who acted in Dodik's favour.
Ona nije registrovana kao strani agent, što bi moglo biti u sukobu s američkim pravilima o lobiranju.
She is not registered as a foreign agent, which could conflict with American lobbying rules.

title: Hakeri tvrde da su otkrili podatke o 450.000 ratnih smrti
Hackers claim they found data on 450,000 war deaths
body: Dvije hakerske grupe tvrde da su provalile u bazu podataka ruske statističke agencije Rosstat.
Two hacker groups claim they broke into the database of the Russian statistics agency Rosstat.
Kažu da su pronašli podatke o smrtima povezanim s ratom u Ukrajini od februara 2022. do augusta 2026.
They say they found data on deaths linked to the war in Ukraine from February 2022 to August 2026.
Procjenjuju da je poginulo između 394.000 i 450.000 ljudi.
They estimate that between 394,000 and 450,000 people died.
Grupa Belarusian Cyberpartisans navodi najmanje 393.881 smrt, jer je brojala samo zapise s ratom kao uzrokom.
The group Belarusian Cyberpartisans states at least 393,881 deaths, because it counted only records with war as the cause.
Grupa Silent Crow spominje do 450.100 smrti, a u taj broj ulaze i vojnici koji su umrli bez borbe.
The group Silent Crow mentions up to 450,100 deaths, and that number also includes soldiers who died outside combat.
Napad se dogodio u noći između 31. oktobra i 1. novembra, a hakeri kažu da su preuzeli oko 23 terabajta podataka.
The attack happened in the night between 31 October and 1 November, and the hackers say they downloaded about 23 terabytes of data.
Kyiv Independent nije mogao provjeriti ove tvrdnje.
Kyiv Independent could not verify these claims.
Rosstat potvrđuje da je bio meta napada, ali poriče da su podaci procurili.
Rosstat confirms it was the target of attacks, but denies that data leaked.
Rusija ne objavljuje koliko je vojnika poginulo, a Rosstat od 2024. ne objavljuje ni uzroke smrti.
Russia does not publish how many soldiers died, and since 2024 Rosstat has not published causes of death either.
Mediazona i BBC su do 6. novembra imenom potvrdili 285.881 poginulog ruskog vojnika, ali pravi broj je znatno veći.
By 6 November, Mediazona and the BBC had confirmed by name 285,881 dead Russian soldiers, but the real number is much higher.

title: Jokić nadigrao Zubca u Mexico Cityju
Jokić outplayed Zubac in Mexico City
body: Denver je u Mexico Cityju pobijedio Indianu rezultatom 114:102.
Denver beat Indiana 114:102 in Mexico City.
Nikola Jokić ubacio je 19 poena, uz 13 skokova i 8 asistencija.
Nikola Jokić scored 19 points, with 13 rebounds and 8 assists.
Čak 10 poena postigao je već u prvoj četvrtini.
He scored as many as 10 points already in the first quarter.
Ivica Zubac, koji je u februari došao iz Clippersa, imao je 10 poena i 12 skokova.
Ivica Zubac, who came from the Clippers in February, had 10 points and 12 rebounds.
Denver je poluvrijeme završio sa 64:41 i u njemu praktično riješio utakmicu.
Denver finished the first half 64:41 and practically decided the game in it.
Indiana je igrala bez Tyresea Haliburtona.
Indiana played without Tyrese Haliburton.
Pacersi su u trećoj četvrtini smanjili zaostatak, ali nisu uspjeli preokrenuti rezultat, pa su sada na omjeru 3-7.
In the third quarter the Pacers cut the deficit, but they could not turn the result around, so they are now at 3-7.
Mario Hezonja igrao je 18 minuta bez poena, a pogodio nije nijedan od šest šuteva.
Mario Hezonja played 18 minutes without a point, and he hit none of six shots.
U drugim utakmicama New York je dobio Cleveland 109:97, a Golden State je nakon produžetka pobijedio Orlando 126:119.
In other games New York beat Cleveland 109:97, and Golden State beat Orlando 126:119 after overtime.
Stephen Curry je postigao 41 poen.
Stephen Curry scored 41 points.

title: Preminuo Boba Orlić, pionir beogradske rok scene
Boba Orlić, a pioneer of the Belgrade rock scene, has died
body: Preminuo je Slobodan Boba Orlić, jedan od pionira beogradske rok scene.
Slobodan Boba Orlić, one of the pioneers of the Belgrade rock scene, has died.
Bio je basist i muzički producent, a na sceni je djelovao skoro šest decenija.
He was a bassist and music producer, and he was active on the scene for almost six decades.
Vijest je na društvenim mrežama objavio muzičar Srđan Marjanović, a podijelila ju je i izdavačka kuća PGP RTS.
The news was published on social media by musician Srđan Marjanović, and the record label PGP RTS also shared it.
Karijeru je počeo šezdesetih godina i svirao je u grupama Bitnici, Siluete, Plameni 5 i Opus.
He started his career in the 1960s and played in the bands Bitnici, Siluete, Plameni 5 and Opus.
Kasnije se posvetio snimanju zvuka i produkciji.
Later he devoted himself to sound recording and production.
Radio je s mnogim poznatim bendovima, među kojima su Goblini, Eyesburn, Kristali i Ljubičice.
He worked with many well-known bands, among them Goblini, Eyesburn, Kristali and Ljubičice.
Posljednjih godina ponovo je svirao s gitaristom Brankom Milanovićem u grupi Koprive.
In recent years he played again with guitarist Branko Milanović in the band Koprive.
Oni su 2023. objavili album "Povratak".
In 2023 they released the album "Povratak".
Uzrok smrti i datum sahrane nisu poznati.
The cause of death and the date of the funeral are not known.

title: Turski hirurzi upozoravaju na čudne estetske zahtjeve
Turkish surgeons warn about unusual cosmetic requests
body: Plastični hirurzi u Turskoj sve češće primaju neobične zahtjeve za estetske operacije.
Plastic surgeons in Turkey increasingly receive unusual requests for cosmetic operations.
Smatraju da je za to djelimično kriva društvena mreža, na kojoj se takve operacije prikazuju kao jednostavne.
They think social media is partly to blame, as such operations are shown there as simple.
Neki pacijenti žele manja stopala jer vjeruju da će im cipele tako ljepše stajati.
Some patients want smaller feet because they believe shoes will look nicer on them.
Žene traže uže ramena da im odjeća bolje stoji, a muškarci šira ramena da izgledaju atletski.
Women ask for narrower shoulders so clothes fit better, and men ask for wider shoulders to look athletic.
Profesor Yakup Čil kaže da ove operacije nisu nimalo jednostavne i da svaka nosi komplikacije.
Professor Yakup Čil says these operations are not simple at all and that each carries complications.
Slične zahvate rade kod urođenih anomalija, ali čisto estetske operacije treba izbjegavati.
Similar procedures are done for congenital anomalies, but purely cosmetic operations should be avoided.
Većina zahtjeva dolazi od ljudi od 20 do 30 godina, koji najviše koriste društvene mreže.
Most requests come from people aged 20 to 30, who use social media the most.
Docent Emre Hocaoglu primjećuje da mladi traže od roditelja estetske zahvate kao nagradu za dobar uspjeh u školi.
Docent Emre Hocaoglu notices that young people ask their parents for cosmetic procedures as a reward for good results at school.
Djeca, kaže, umjesto bicikla traže filere za usne.
Children, he says, ask for lip fillers instead of a bicycle.
Upozorava da svaka operacija nosi rizik, pa savjetuje izbor iskusnog doktora.
He warns that every operation carries risk, so he advises choosing an experienced doctor.

title: U Zagrebu obilježeno deset godina stećaka na UNESCO-voj listi
Ten years of stećci on the UNESCO list marked in Zagreb
body: U Zagrebu je održan okrugli stol o stećcima povodom deset godina od njihovog upisa na UNESCO-ovu listu svjetske baštine.
A roundtable about stećci was held in Zagreb on the occasion of ten years since their inscription on UNESCO's World Heritage List.
Skup su organizovali hrvatsko kulturno društvo Napredak i Ambasada Bosne i Hercegovine u Zagrebu.
The event was organised by the Croatian cultural society Napredak and the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Zagreb.
Otvorile su ga ambasadorica Elma Kovačević-Bajtal i Goran Štrbac.
It was opened by Ambassador Elma Kovačević-Bajtal and Goran Štrbac.
UNESCO je 2016. upisao 28 nekropola s oko 4.000 stećaka iz BiH, Hrvatske, Crne Gore i Srbije.
In 2016 UNESCO inscribed 28 necropolises with about 4,000 stećci from BiH, Croatia, Montenegro and Serbia.
Većina sačuvanih stećaka nalazi se u Bosni i Hercegovini.
Most of the preserved stećci are in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Historičar Nedim Rabić rekao je da natpisi na stećcima otkrivaju ljude koji se rijetko pojavljuju u drugim izvorima.
Historian Nedim Rabić said that inscriptions on stećci reveal people who rarely appear in other sources.
Veće i bogatije ukrašene stećke povezao je s ekonomskim rastom Bosne u 14. stoljeću.
He linked the larger and more richly decorated stećci with Bosnia's economic growth in the 14th century.
Rabić je naglasio da ih istraživači proučavaju više od 150 godina, a da nauka još nema posljednju riječ.
Rabić stressed that researchers have studied them for more than 150 years, and that science still does not have the last word.
Njihovi motivi danas se pojavljuju na novčanicama i poštanskim markama.
Their motifs today appear on banknotes and postage stamps.
Učesnici su pozvali na nastavak saradnje četiri države u istraživanju i zaštiti nekropola.
Participants called for the four countries to continue cooperation in researching and protecting the necropolises.

title: Policija vodenim topom rastjerala demonstrante u Tirani
Police used a water cannon to disperse protesters in Tirana
body: U Tirani je policija vodenim topom rastjerala grupu demonstranata, od kojih su neki bili maskirani.
In Tirana, police used a water cannon to disperse a group of protesters, some of whom were masked.
Incident se dogodio u blizini albanskog Ministarstva obrazovanja.
The incident happened near the Albanian Ministry of Education.
Studenti su ponovo pozvali na protest nakon nekoliko sedmica sukoba.
Students called for a protest again after several weeks of clashes.
Protesti traju od sredine oktobra i proširili su se na druge gradove.
The protests have lasted since mid-October and have spread to other cities.
Demonstranti kažu da su nezadovoljni korupcijom u vladi, nedostatkom posla i lošim uslovima u obrazovanju.
The protesters say they are unhappy about corruption in the government, the lack of jobs and poor conditions in education.
Prije toga su tokom ljeta održani uglavnom mirni protesti protiv luksuznog projekta na obali, koji podržava Jared Kushner.
Before that, mostly peaceful protests were held during the summer against a luxury project on the coast, which Jared Kushner supports.
Agencija Reuters piše da je ovo dosad najveći izazov za premijera Edija Ramu.
The Reuters agency writes that this is the biggest challenge so far for Prime Minister Edi Rama.
On je na vlasti od 2013, a prošle godine je osvojio četvrti mandat.
He has been in power since 2013, and last year he won a fourth term.

title: Čelik u nadoknadi ostao bez pobjede u Mostaru protiv Veleža
Čelik left without a win against Velež in Mostar in stoppage time
body: Velež i Čelik su u 13. kolu Premijer lige BiH odigrali neriješeno 1:1 u Mostaru.
Velež and Čelik drew 1:1 in Mostar in round 13 of the Bosnian Premier League.
Gosti iz Zenice bili su blizu pobjede, ali su gol primili u sudijskoj nadoknadi.
The visitors from Zenica were close to victory, but they conceded a goal in stoppage time.
Vidić je doveo Čelik u vodstvo u 59. minuti udarcem lijevom nogom sa oko 18 metara.
Vidić put Čelik in the lead in the 59th minute with a left-foot shot from about 18 metres.
Gol je prvo provjeravan zbog moguće ofsajda, ali je VAR potvrdio da je regularan.
The goal was first checked for a possible offside, but VAR confirmed that it was valid.
Velež je u 7. minuti tražio jedanaesterac zbog igranja rukom, ali je sudija Amin Efendić nakon provjere odbio zahtjev.
In the 7th minute Velež asked for a penalty because of a handball, but referee Amin Efendić rejected the claim after a check.
U 34. minuti golman Ribić je branio udarce Vidića i Gogića.
In the 34th minute goalkeeper Ribić saved shots from Vidić and Gogić.
Domaći su imali šanse i u nastavku, a Mešić je u 70. minuti promašio dobru priliku.
The home side also had chances later on, and Mešić missed a good opportunity in the 70th minute.
U 92. minuti Horić je rukom zaustavio loptu nakon centaršuta, pa je Velež dobio jedanaesterac.
In the 92nd minute Horić stopped the ball with his hand after a cross, so Velež got a penalty.
Hrkać ga je realizovao i spasio bod domaćinima.
Hrkać scored it and saved a point for the hosts.
Trener Čelika Bojan Regoje isključen je prije kraja utakmice jer je bio nezadovoljan suđenjem.
Čelik coach Bojan Regoje was sent off before the end of the match because he was unhappy with the refereeing.

title: Radna grupa za branu na Crnoj rijeci nije se sastala nijednom
The working group for the Crna rijeka dam has not met even once
body: Radna grupa koja treba pripremiti projektni zadatak za branu na Crnoj rijeci nije se sastala nijednom.
The working group that is supposed to prepare the design assignment for the dam on Crna rijeka has not met even once.
To tvrdi Agencija za vodno područje rijeke Save.
This is what the Sava River Basin Agency says.
Agencija je imenovala svog predstavnika 7. marta 2025, nakon zahtjeva Ministarstva privrede Kantona Sarajevo.
The agency named its representative on 7 March 2025, after a request from the Ministry of Economy of Sarajevo Canton.
Od tada nije dobila nikakve informacije o radu grupe.
Since then it has received no information about the group's work.
Ni Bijela ni Crna rijeka nisu u planu upravljanja vodama za period 2022–2027.
Neither Bijela nor Crna rijeka is in the water management plan for 2022–2027.
Akumulacija na Crnoj rijeci imala bi oko 62,3 miliona kubnih metara vode i površinu od oko 224 hektara.
The reservoir on Crna rijeka would hold about 62.3 million cubic metres of water and cover about 224 hectares.
Djelimično bi potopila oko 25 vikendica i dio puta Sarajevo–Goražde.
It would partly flood about 25 weekend houses and part of the Sarajevo–Goražde road.
Od 2000. do 2006. za projekat je potrošeno 1,12 miliona KM.
From 2000 to 2006, 1.12 million KM was spent on the project.
Ministar Mladen Pandurević rekao je početkom oktobra da projekat još nije počeo.
Minister Mladen Pandurević said in early October that the project had not started yet.
Agencija je dala i podatke o podzemnim vodama kod Bačeva.
The agency also gave data on groundwater near Bačevo.
Nivo vode je ove godine u prosjeku 3,17 metara niži nego u periodu 2017–2025, ali nije na desetogodišnjem minimumu.
The water level this year is on average 3.17 metres lower than in 2017–2025, but it is not at the ten-year minimum.
Kanton Sarajevo je od 2023. do kraja septembra 2026. prikupio oko 70,5 miliona KM vodnih naknada.
From 2023 to the end of September 2026, Sarajevo Canton collected about 70.5 million KM in water fees.

title: Biković odgovorio ruskom voditelju koji je tražio da govori srpski
Biković answered the Russian host who asked him to speak Serbian
body: Srpski glumac Miloš Biković gostovao je u emisiji "Šou Volje" na ruskom kanalu TNT.
The Serbian actor Miloš Biković was a guest on the show "Šou Volje" on the Russian channel TNT.
Voditelj Pavel Volja zamolio ga je da progovori srpski kako bi vidio hoće li ga razumjeti.
The host Pavel Volja asked him to speak Serbian to see whether he would understand him.
Biković mu je na srpskom uzvratio pitanjem da li stvarno misli da može da shvati kada on priča srpski.
Biković answered him in Serbian with a question: does he really think he can understand when he speaks Serbian.
Voditelj je bio iznenađen i pokušao je razumjeti barem dio rečenice, a publika je aplaudirala glumcu.
The host was surprised and tried to understand at least part of the sentence, and the audience applauded the actor.
Snimak je objavljen na Instagram profilu emisije i za tri dana imao je oko 4 miliona pregleda.
The clip was posted on the show's Instagram profile and had about 4 million views in three days.
Epizoda je emitovana 25. oktobra.
The episode was broadcast on 25 October.
U razgovoru je Biković pričao i o ocu i porodici.
In the conversation Biković also talked about being a father and about his family.
Vikende provodi sa suprugom Ivanom i sinom Vasilijem.
He spends weekends with his wife Ivana and his son Vasilije.
Govorio je i o novom historijskom filmu "Rođenje imperije", u kojem igra Aleksandra Menšikova.
He also spoke about the new historical film "Rođenje imperije", in which he plays Alexander Menshikov.

title: Trump potvrdio nove udare na iransko ostrvo Kešm
Trump confirmed new strikes on the Iranian island of Qeshm
body: Donald Trump potvrdio je da su američke snage u noći s petka na subotu izvele nove udare na Iran.
Donald Trump confirmed that US forces carried out new strikes on Iran on the night from Friday to Saturday.
Meta je bio protuzračni sistem na ostrvu Kešm u Hormuškom moreuzu.
The target was an air defence system on Qeshm island in the Strait of Hormuz.
Trump je rekao da su to bili manji udari i da su uništili mali protuzračni uređaj za 15 minuta, možda i za pet.
Trump said these were smaller strikes and that they destroyed a small air defence device in 15 minutes, maybe even five.
Dodao je da SAD pregovaraju s Iranom i da postoji veliki napredak.
He added that the US is negotiating with Iran and that there is great progress.
Iranski državni mediji javljaju da su dvije rakete pogodile područje Suza na Kešmu, ali nisu naveli štetu.
Iranian state media report that two missiles hit the Suza area on Qeshm, but they did not say what damage was done.
Državna televizija tvrdi i da je protuzračna odbrana oborila američku bespilotnu letjelicu MQ-9, što niko nije nezavisno potvrdio.
State television also claims that air defence shot down a US MQ-9 drone, which nobody has independently confirmed.
Američka Centralna komanda nije izdala saopćenje i rekla je samo da je situacija relativno mirna.
The US Central Command did not issue a statement and said only that the situation is relatively calm.
Katar je odbacio tvrdnje da su pregovori SAD-a i Irana propali.
Qatar rejected claims that the talks between the US and Iran have failed.
Ovo su prvi američki udari na Iran nakon izbora za Kongres u utorak, na kojima je Trumpova stranka loše prošla.
These are the first US strikes on Iran since Tuesday's congressional elections, in which Trump's party did badly.
Trump je rezultat objasnio ratom s Iranom.
Trump explained the result with the war with Iran.

title: Posljednji ledenjak u Alpama Allgäu mogao bi nestati do ljeta
The last glacier in the Allgäu Alps could disappear by summer
body: Ledenjak Schwarzmilzferner u austrijskom dijelu Alpa Allgäu više se ne smatra ledenjakom.
The Schwarzmilzferner glacier in the Austrian part of the Allgäu Alps is no longer considered a glacier.
Nalazi se na oko 2.450 metara nadmorske visine, blizu granice Austrije i Njemačke.
It is located at about 2,450 metres above sea level, near the border between Austria and Germany.
Ovo toplo ljeto smanjilo mu je debljinu za više od 4 metra i uzelo mu oko polovine zapremine.
This warm summer reduced its thickness by more than 4 metres and took about half of its volume.
Glaciolozi kažu da je kretanje glavna osobina ledenjaka, a Schwarzmilzferner se više ne kreće.
Glaciologists say that movement is the main feature of a glacier, and Schwarzmilzferner no longer moves.
Naučnici ga prate već 26 godina i bilježe velike gubitke leda od 2016, a od 2022. se taj trend pojačao.
Scientists have been following it for 26 years and have recorded big ice losses since 2016, and since 2022 this trend has become stronger.
Christoph Mayer s Bavarske akademije nauka rekao je da će on vrlo vjerovatno potpuno nestati do narednog ljeta.
Christoph Mayer of the Bavarian Academy of Sciences said that it will very likely disappear completely by next summer.
Svake godine nestane nekoliko manjih alpskih ledenjaka jer su ljeta previše topla za njih.
Every year several smaller Alpine glaciers disappear because summers are too warm for them.
Mayer taj proces opisuje kao praktično nezaustavljiv.
Mayer describes this process as practically unstoppable.
Očekuje se da će cijele Istočne Alpe ostati bez leda između 2060. i 2070. godine.
It is expected that the whole of the Eastern Alps will be ice-free between 2060 and 2070.

title: Pucnjava u Krakowu: pet mrtvih nakon napada na glavnom trgu
Shooting in Krakow: five dead after an attack on the main square
body: U poljskom gradu Krakowu napadač je autom ušao na glavni trg i počeo pucati.
In the Polish city of Krakow, an attacker drove a car onto the main square and started shooting.
Policija kaže da je pucao na nasumične prolaznike.
Police say he shot at random passersby.
Najmanje pet osoba je ubijeno, a više od deset je povrijeđeno.
At least five people were killed and more than ten were injured.
Policija je objavila vijest na mreži X oko 15:00 po lokalnom vremenu.
Police posted the news on the network X at about 15:00 local time.
Prvo je rekla da je napadač uhapšen, a kasnije da su ga policajci ranili i odveli u bolnicu.
First they said the attacker had been arrested, and later that officers had wounded him and taken him to hospital.
Među povrijeđenima su i policajci.
Police officers are among the injured.
Gradska uprava potvrdila je pucnjavu i rekla da policija radi i u ulici Dietla.
The city administration confirmed the shooting and said police were also working on Dietla street.
Motiv napada i identitet žrtava još nisu poznati.
The motive for the attack and the victims' identities are not yet known.
Premijer Donald Tusk rekao je da policija istražuje pozadinu i okolnosti napada.
Prime Minister Donald Tusk said the police are investigating the background and circumstances of the attack.
Krakow je drugi po veličini grad u Poljskoj, a njegov glavni trg je jedno od najposjećenijih mjesta u zemlji.
Krakow is the second largest city in Poland, and its main square is one of the most visited places in the country.

title: Građani Sarajeva donirali kosu djeci oboljeloj od raka
Citizens of Sarajevo donated hair to children with cancer
body: U Sarajevu su mnogi građani, mladi i stariji, donirali kosu za djecu oboljelu od raka.
In Sarajevo many citizens, young and old, donated hair for children with cancer.
Šišanje je dio projekta "Moja kosa, tvoja kosa" koji vodi Udruženje Srce za djecu oboljelu od raka.
The haircut event is part of the project "Moja kosa, tvoja kosa", run by the association Srce for children with cancer.
Direktor Fikret Kubat objasnio je da donirana kosa pomaže djeci da dobiju perike, koje im donose radost i utjehu.
Director Fikret Kubat explained that donated hair helps children get wigs, which bring them joy and comfort.
Perike pravi dvoje majstora, a za jednu je potrebno oko 20 pramenova kose.
Two craftspeople make the wigs, and about 20 strands of hair are needed for one.
Za devet godina projekta napravljeno je 116 perika, a djeca čine 80 posto donatora.
In nine years of the project 116 wigs have been made, and children make up 80 percent of the donors.
Ove godine je napravljeno 10 perika, 5 je popravljeno, a primljeno je oko 2.300 donacija kose.
This year 10 wigs were made, 5 were repaired, and about 2,300 hair donations were received.
Kosa mora biti prirodna, neofarbana, bez hemijskih tretmana, duga najmanje 40 centimetara, čista i potpuno suha.
The hair must be natural, undyed, without chemical treatments, at least 40 centimetres long, clean and completely dry.
Projekat se može podržati i pozivom na broj 17010, kojim se donira 2 KM.
The project can also be supported by calling 17010, which donates 2 KM.
Kubat je rekao da je iza svakog doniranog pramena priča o ljubavi i solidarnosti.
Kubat said that behind every donated strand there is a story of love and solidarity.

title: Armin Muzaferija održao emotivan koncert u Bugojnu
Armin Muzaferija gave an emotional concert in Bugojno
body: Pjevač Armin Muzaferija sinoć je održao koncert u Sportskom centru u Bugojnu.
The singer Armin Muzaferija gave a concert last night at the Sports Centre in Bugojno.
Dvorana je bila puna, a koncert je organizovao Kulturno-sportski centar Bugojno.
The hall was full, and the concert was organised by the Bugojno Cultural and Sports Centre.
S njim su nastupili hafiz Aziz Alili, Vokalni ansambl Bugojno i Gradski folklorni ansambl Bugojno.
Performing with him were hafiz Aziz Alili, the Bugojno Vocal Ensemble and the Bugojno City Folklore Ensemble.
Jedan od najdirljivijih trenutaka bila je pjesma "Hadžija".
One of the most moving moments was the song "Hadžija".
Muzaferija je rekao da ona govori o nepravdi i istinitom događaju.
Muzaferija said that it speaks about injustice and a true event.
Večer je iskoristio da skrene pažnju na nepravdu koju proživljava palestinski narod.
He used the evening to draw attention to the injustice that the Palestinian people are living through.
Dio programa bio je i nastup derviša.
A dervish performance was also part of the programme.
Muzaferija uskoro nastupa i u inostranstvu.
Muzaferija will also perform abroad soon.
Njegovi koncerti u njemačkim gradovima Kelnu i Kamp-Lintfortu već su rasprodani.
His concerts in the German cities of Cologne and Kamp-Lintfort are already sold out.

title: Britanija tužena zbog oduzetih prava građana EU nakon Brexita
Britain sued over residence rights taken from EU citizens after Brexit
body: Organizacija the3million tužila je britansko Ministarstvo unutrašnjih poslova pred Visokim sudom.
The organization the3million has sued the British Home Office at the High Court.
Tvrde da je ministarstvo prekršilo sporazum o izlasku iz EU kada je skoro 1.500 građana EU izgubilo sva ili dio prava boravka.
They claim the ministry broke the withdrawal agreement when nearly 1,500 EU citizens lost all or part of their residence rights.
Neki ljudi koji su nakon Brexita dobili privremeni status naknadno su čuli da je to bila greška.
Some people who received a temporary status after Brexit were later told that it had been a mistake.
Među njima je 33-godišnji inženjer s brazilskim i italijanskim državljanstvom koji u Londonu živi od 2018.
Among them is a 33-year-old engineer with Brazilian and Italian citizenship who has lived in London since 2018.
Prvo su mu rekli da smije ostati, a njegova supruga iz Brazila ne smije, ali je ta odluka u zadnjim sedmicama poništena nakon prigovora.
First they told him he could stay but his wife from Brazil could not, but that decision was reversed in recent weeks after an objection.
Ministarstvo je nekim Brazilcima italijanskog porijekla rekalo da su status dobili greškom jer nisu priložili italijanski pasoš.
The ministry told some Brazilians of Italian descent that they got their status by mistake because they had not attached an Italian passport.
U oktobru je ministarstvo ipak prihvatilo da će one koji dokažu italijansko državljanstvo po porijeklu tretirati kao Italijane od rođenja.
In October the ministry did accept that it would treat those who prove Italian citizenship by descent as Italians from birth.
Monique Hawkins iz organizacije rekla je da ministarstvo ljudima uskraćuje zaštitu koju sporazum garantuje, uključujući pravo na žalbu.
Monique Hawkins from the organization said the ministry denies people the protection that the agreement guarantees, including the right to appeal.
Zatražili su od suda da politiku „greške“ proglasi nezakonitom.
They asked the court to declare the "mistake" policy unlawful.
Ministarstvo je odgovorilo da ne može komentarisati jer je postupak u toku.
The ministry replied that it cannot comment because the case is ongoing.

title: Osam decenija poslije voz ponovo povezao Brčko i Banoviće
Eight decades later, a train has again connected Brčko and Banovići
body: Svečani voz vozio je u subotu na relaciji Banovići–Brčko–Banovići.
A ceremonial train ran on Saturday on the route Banovići–Brčko–Banovići.
Time je obilježeno 80 godina od izgradnje omladinske pruge Brčko–Banovići.
This marked 80 years since the construction of the Brčko–Banovići youth railway.
Vožnju su pripremile Željeznice Federacije BiH i Željeznice Republike Srpske, a na stanici u Banovićima okupili su se nekadašnji učesnici radnih akcija, željezničari i građani.

The ride was prepared by the Railways of the Federation of BiH and the Railways of Republika Srpska, and former participants of work actions, railway workers and citizens gathered at the station in Banovići.
Prugu je 1946. godine golim rukama gradila omladina iz cijele Jugoslavije, a došlo je i oko 2.000 mladih iz inostranstva.
The railway was built in 1946 by hand by young people from all over Yugoslavia, and about 2,000 young people from abroad also came.
Radilo se u teškim uslovima i s malo mašina, a posao je završen 22 dana prije roka.
They worked in hard conditions and with few machines, and the job was finished 22 days before the deadline.
Pruga duga 87,8 kilometara ima 3 tunela, 22 mosta i 14 stanica.
The 87.8-kilometre railway has 3 tunnels, 22 bridges and 14 stations.
Prvi voz s banovićkim ugljenom svečano je 7. novembra 1946. ušao u beogradsku željezničku stanicu.
The first train with coal from Banovići ceremonially entered Belgrade's railway station on 7 November 1946.
Nijaz Husić rekao je da su radne akcije bile masovne i dobrovoljne te da je takvu mobilizaciju danas teško ponoviti.
Nijaz Husić said that work actions were massive and voluntary and that such mobilization is hard to repeat today.
Zlatko Dukić podsjetio je da Tuzla trenutno nema željeznicu i da ova godišnjica podsjeća na ono što je region imao.
Zlatko Dukić reminded that Tuzla currently has no railway and that this anniversary is a reminder of what the region once had.
Mašinovođa Jasmin Selimović, koji većinom vozi teretne vozove, prvi put je vozio ovakav putnički voz.
Locomotive driver Jasmin Selimović, who mostly drives freight trains, drove this kind of passenger train for the first time.

title: Robert Pattinson u utrci za ulogu Jamesa Bonda
Robert Pattinson is in the running for the role of James Bond
body: Glumac Robert Pattinson među je glumcima koji su išli na probno snimanje za ulogu Jamesa Bonda.
Actor Robert Pattinson is among the actors who went to a screen test for the role of James Bond.
Tako piše Hollywood Reporter, pozivajući se na više izvora.
This is what the Hollywood Reporter writes, citing several sources.
Probna snimanja održana su prema tim izvorima u vikendu 24. oktobra u Londonu.
According to these sources, the screen tests took place on the weekend of 24 October in London.
Među kandidatima se spominju i Callum Turner, Jack Lowden i Josh O'Connor.
Callum Turner, Jack Lowden and Josh O'Connor are also mentioned among the candidates.
Navodno se razmatra i Nicholas Hoult, koji je nekada bio u užem izboru za Batmana, ulogu koju je na kraju dobio Pattinson.
Nicholas Hoult is reportedly also being considered; he was once on the shortlist for Batman, a role that Pattinson finally got.
Novi film o Bondu režira Denis Villeneuve, s kojim je Pattinson radio na filmu „Dune: Part Three“.
The new Bond film is directed by Denis Villeneuve, with whom Pattinson worked on the film "Dune: Part Three".
Prema izvještaju, saradnja je prošla dobro.
According to the report, the cooperation went well.
Ovo će biti prvi film o Bondu pod kontrolom kompanije Amazon, koja je prava kupila od porodice Broccoli u februaru 2025.
This will be the first Bond film under the control of Amazon, which bought the rights from the Broccoli family in February 2025.
Producenti su Amy Pascal i David Heyman.
The producers are Amy Pascal and David Heyman.
Amazon nije komentarisao izvještaje.
Amazon did not comment on the reports.
Potraga za novim Bondom počela je 21 godinu nakon što je Daniel Craig dobio tu ulogu.
The search for a new Bond comes 21 years after Daniel Craig got the role.

title: Iranska garda: spremni smo ako se promijeni nuklearna doktrina
Iranian Guard: we are ready if the nuclear doctrine changes
body: Glasnogovornik iranske Revolucionarne garde poručio je da je garda spremna na svaku stratešku promjenu.
The spokesperson of Iran's Revolutionary Guard said that the Guard is ready for any strategic change.
Brigadni general Hossein Mohebbi rekao je da će se napraviti potrebne pripreme ako rukovodstvo odluči promijeniti nuklearnu doktrinu.
Brigadier General Hossein Mohebbi said that the necessary preparations will be made if the leadership decides to change the nuclear doctrine.
Članak naglašava da je to samo uslovna izjava, a ne najava nove politike.
The article stresses that this is only a conditional statement, not an announcement of a new policy.
Mohebbi je također rekao da imovina neprijateljskih zemalja nije ograničena njihovim granicama.
Mohebbi also said that the assets of enemy countries are not limited by their borders.
Prema njegovim riječima, iranske snage oružje prave vlastitim znanjem i ne uvoze ga iz inostranstva.
According to him, Iranian forces make weapons with their own knowledge and do not import them from abroad.
Spomenuo je i rad na povećanju dometa iranskih raketa.
He also mentioned work on increasing the range of Iranian missiles.
Njegove riječi dolaze nakon naredbe vrhovnog vođe Mojtabe Khameneija da se na prijetnje odgovori bez geografskih ograničenja.
His words come after an order from Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei to respond to threats without geographic limits.
Zabrana nuklearnog oružja u Iranu zasniva se na fetvi iz 2003. godine, a u Teheranu je nakon ovogodišnjih napada SAD-a i Izraela sve više zahtjeva da se ukine.
Iran's ban on nuclear weapons is based on a fatwa from 2003, and in Tehran there are more and more calls to lift it after this year's attacks by the US and Israel.
Zvaničnici su prošle sedmice rekli da nova odluka o doktrini još nije donesena.
Officials said last week that no new decision on the doctrine has been made yet.

title: SAD nudi do 20 miliona dolara za informacije o iranskom nuklearnom programu
The US offers up to 20 million dollars for information on Iran's nuclear program
body: Američka Centralna komanda (CENTCOM) objavila je da Washington nudi do 20 miliona dolara za informacije o nuklearnom programu Irana.
The US Central Command (CENTCOM) announced that Washington is offering up to 20 million dollars for information about Iran's nuclear program.
Nagradu isplaćuje program Rewards for Justice američkog State Departmenta.
The reward is paid by the Rewards for Justice program of the US State Department.
Poziv je objavljen na mreži X, uz link na stranicu na kojoj se mogu poslati informacije.
The call was posted on X, with a link to the page where information can be sent.
Nagrada se odnosi na nuklearna postrojenja, opremu i osoblje, posebno naučnike, kao i na njihovo kretanje.
The reward applies to nuclear facilities, equipment and staff, especially scientists, as well as their movement.
Ako je informacija vrijedna, doušnik bi mogao dobiti i preseljenje i novi dom izvan Irana.
If the information is valuable, an informant could also get relocation and a new home outside Iran.
Ranije ove godine SAD je nudio po 10 miliona dolara za informacije o komandantima Revolucionarne garde, pa je nova nagrada duplo veća.
Earlier this year the US offered 10 million dollars each for information about Revolutionary Guard commanders, so the new reward is twice as big.
Predsjednik Donald Trump više puta je tvrdio da je iranski nuklearni program uništen.
President Donald Trump has claimed several times that Iran's nuclear program has been destroyed.
Prema pisanju Times of Israela, potvrdio je i nove, manje udare na Iran, prve nakon američkih izbora.
According to the Times of Israel, he also confirmed new, smaller strikes on Iran, the first since the US elections.
Iranski zvaničnik rekao je za Reuters da je Teheran preko Dohe poslao Washingtonu poseban nuklearni prijedlog, ali da neće odustati od zaliha obogaćenog uranija.
An Iranian official told Reuters that Tehran sent Washington a separate nuclear proposal through Doha, but that it will not give up its stocks of enriched uranium.

title: Naselje Malta u Sarajevu dobilo novu pijacu
The Malta neighborhood in Sarajevo has a new green market
body: Stanovnici sarajevskog naselja Malta od danas imaju svoju pijacu.
Residents of the Malta neighborhood in Sarajevo have their own market from today.
Nalazi se na platou u blizini pošte i zgrade BH Telecoma, a ovdje se prodaje svježe voće i povrće.
It is located on a plateau near the post office and the BH Telecom building, and fresh fruit and vegetables are sold here.
To je prva pijaca na ovom dijelu desne obale Miljacke.
It is the first market on this part of the right bank of the Miljacka.
Projekat su zajedno pokrenuli Općina Novo Sarajevo i preduzeće „Tržnice-pijace“.
The project was started together by the Municipality of Novo Sarajevo and the company "Tržnice-pijace".
Općina je putem javnog poziva osigurala da svim prodavačima za prvu godinu bude vraćen zakup, a za to je izdvojeno do 100.000 KM.
Through a public call, the municipality made sure that all vendors get their rent refunded for the first year, and up to 100,000 KM was set aside for this.
Načelnica Općine Benjamina Karić rekla je da je to stambeno naselje s mnogo stanara koji sada mogu kupovati namirnice poslije posla ili tokom pauze.
Municipality head Benjamina Karić said this is a residential area with many tenants who can now buy groceries after work or during a break.
Stanovnica Fadila Crnogorac kaže da je pijacu tražila još od 2008. godine jer ovaj dio grada nikada nije imao pijacu.
Resident Fadila Crnogorac says she has been asking for a market since 2008 because this part of the city never had one.
Nada se da će biti zadovoljni i prodavači i kupci.
She hopes that both vendors and buyers will be satisfied.
Na otvorenju je nastupilo KUD „Lola“, građani su dobili besplatnu kafu, a prvi kupci i zdrave pakete voća.
KUD "Lola" performed at the opening, citizens got free coffee, and the first customers also got healthy fruit packages.

title: Bake i djedovi prvog muslimana u Senatu SAD-a ponosni na unuka
The grandparents of the first Muslim in the US Senate are proud of their grandson
body: Abdul El-Sayed pobijedio je u utrci za mjesto u Senatu SAD-a iz Michigana.
Abdul El-Sayed won the race for a seat in the US Senate from Michigan.
Bit će prvi musliman u Senatu, a njegova porodica kaže da je ponosna.
He will be the first Muslim in the Senate, and his family says it is proud.
Judy i Jan Johnson nisu mu biološki baka i djed, ali ga zovu unukom.
Judy and Jan Johnson are not his biological grandmother and grandfather, but they call him their grandson.
Oni su roditelji njegove maćehe Jackie, koja se udala za njegovog oca kada je Abdul imao oko četiri godine.
They are the parents of his stepmother Jackie, who married his father when Abdul was about four years old.
Jan je za ABC News rekao da mu je Abdul od početka ušao u srce.
Jan told ABC News that Abdul entered his heart from the start.
Judy ga opisuje kao dijete koje je bilo izazov, ali je uvijek poštovao starije i s godinama postao disciplinovaniji.
Judy describes him as a child who was a challenge, but who always respected his elders and became more disciplined over the years.
Danas je, kaže, energičan, pametan i iskreno želi pomoći ljudima.
Today, she says, he is energetic, smart and honestly wants to help people.
Kada su je pitali o napadima na unuka zbog vjere, Judy je rekla da se porodica trudila ne gledati negativne stvari.
When she was asked about attacks on her grandson because of his faith, Judy said the family tried not to look at the negative things.
Dok je studirao na Univerzitetu Michigan, Abdul je živio kod njih, a oni su mu pomagali oko radova.
While he studied at the University of Michigan, Abdul lived with them, and they helped him with his papers.
Izborno veče proveli su zajedno na proslavi pobjede.
They spent election night together at the victory celebration.
Planiraju i da zajedno proslave Dan zahvalnosti.
They also plan to celebrate Thanksgiving together.

title: Kako hobiji mogu poboljšati mentalno i emocionalno zdravlje
How hobbies can improve mental and emotional health
body: Hobiji su dobri za mentalno i emocionalno zdravlje, a prednosti su veće ako se hobiju redovno bavimo s drugim ljudima.
Hobbies are good for mental and emotional health, and the benefits are bigger if we do a hobby regularly with other people.
Čak i hobiji koje radimo sami, poput čitanja, vrtlarenja, pečenja ili pletenja, pomažu.
Even hobbies that we do alone, such as reading, gardening, baking or knitting, help.
Članak ih povezuje i s dužim životom.
The article also links them to a longer life.
Psihologinja MaryCatherine McDonald objašnjava da pod stresom mnogo krvi i električne aktivnosti odlazi u dio mozga koji se zove centar straha.
Psychologist MaryCatherine McDonald explains that under stress a lot of blood and electrical activity goes to the part of the brain called the fear center.
To podiže hormone stresa, anksioznost i upalu u tijelu.
This raises stress hormones, anxiety and inflammation in the body.
Hobiji snažno uključuju prefrontalni korteks, pa centar straha prestaje slati alarm.
Hobbies strongly engage the prefrontal cortex, so the fear center stops sending alarms.
Kako kaže, kada se bavimo hobijima, doslovno prespajamo mozak.
As she says, when we do hobbies, we literally rewire the brain.
Zajednički hobi skida pritisak druženja jer odmah imamo o čemu razgovarati, na primjer o knjizi u čitalačkom klubu.
A shared hobby removes the pressure of socializing because we immediately have something to talk about, for example a book in a book club.
Dr. Natasha Thapar-Olmos kaže da dobri odnosi s ljudima smanjuju kortizol i povećavaju dopamin.
Dr. Natasha Thapar-Olmos says that good relationships with people lower cortisol and increase dopamine.
Za korist nije nužan razgovor, dovoljno je biti u istom prostoru s ljudima koji vole istu aktivnost.
Conversation is not necessary for the benefit; it is enough to be in the same space with people who like the same activity.
Važnija je redovnost nego broj susreta, a početnici mogu otići na radionicu ili se pridružiti prijatelju te zaboraviti na perfekcionizam.
Regularity is more important than the number of meetings, and beginners can go to a workshop or join a friend and forget about perfectionism.

title: Raketni napad na Kijev nekoliko dana prije pregovora u Abu Dhabiju
Missile attack on Kyiv a few days before talks in Abu Dhabi
body: Rusija je u subotu ujutro raketama napala Kijev.
Russia attacked Kyiv with missiles on Saturday morning.
Gradonačelnik Vitalij Kličko napisao je na Telegramu da neprijatelj balističkim raketama gađa infrastrukturu u predgrađima.
Mayor Vitali Klitschko wrote on Telegram that the enemy is hitting infrastructure in the suburbs with ballistic missiles.
Dvije osobe su povrijeđene, a gradska vojna uprava je saopćila da su oštećene i zgrade u kojima su stanovi i jedan vrtić.
Two people were injured, and the city military administration announced that buildings with apartments and a kindergarten were also damaged.
Krhotine su pale na zgradu od pet spratova u jednom zapadnom dijelu grada, a na drugoj zgradi je oštećena fasada.
Debris fell on a five-storey building in a western part of the city, and the facade of another building was damaged.
Zvaničnici su satima upozoravali stanovnike da bi mogli doći novi udari.
Officials warned residents for hours that new strikes could come.
Predsjednik Volodimir Zelenski rekao je u večernjem obraćanju da Rusija priprema nove napade na energetska postrojenja, mostove i drugu infrastrukturu.
President Volodymyr Zelensky said in his evening address that Russia is preparing new attacks on energy facilities, bridges and other infrastructure.
Napad dolazi tri dana prije pregovora u Abu Dhabiju, u kojima učestvuju Sjedinjene Države, Ukrajina i Rusija.
The attack comes three days before the talks in Abu Dhabi, in which the United States, Ukraine and Russia are taking part.
Cilj je da se završi rat koji traje već četiri i po godine.
The goal is to end the war that has lasted for four and a half years.
Posljednji krug pregovora održan je u februaru.
The last round of talks was held in February.

title: Demokrati poručili novom šefu Trumpovog kabineta da uzme advokata
Democrats told Trump's new chief of staff to get a lawyer
body: Stephen Miller u ponedjeljak postaje novi šef kabineta u Bijeloj kući.
Stephen Miller becomes the new White House chief of staff on Monday.
Ima 41 godinu i uz Trumpa je od prvog mandata, a od 2025. je zamjenik šefa kabineta.
He is 41 years old and has been with Trump since the first term, and since 2025 he has been deputy chief of staff.
Demokrati su na izborima osvojili oba doma Kongresa i najavili su istragu o njegovoj politici prema migrantima.
The Democrats won both houses of Congress in the elections and announced an investigation into his migration policy.
Robert Garcia iz Demokratske stranke rekao je da Miller treba uzeti advokata.
Robert Garcia from the Democratic Party said that Miller should get a lawyer.
Hakeem Jeffries, koji bi mogao postati predsjednik Predstavničkog doma, nazvao ga je neodgovornim ekstremistom.
Hakeem Jeffries, who could become speaker of the House, called him a reckless extremist.
Miller je odgovorio da je misija jasnija nego ikad, a ministar odbrane Pete Hegseth je napisao da patrioti imaju kontrolu.
Miller replied that the mission is clearer than ever, and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth wrote that patriots are in control.
Jedan zvaničnik Bijele kuće rekao je da Trump ne mijenja kurs i da nagrađuje svoje najodanije saradnike.
A White House official said that Trump is not changing course and is rewarding his most loyal aides.
Miller je postavio cilj od 3.000 hapšenja dnevno, a prema jednoj anketi 54% Amerikanaca ne podržava tu politiku.
Miller set a goal of 3,000 arrests per day, and according to one poll 54% of Americans do not support that policy.
Dosadašnja šefica kabineta Susie Wiles podnijela je ostavku i prelazi u Trumpov politički tim.
The previous chief of staff Susie Wiles has resigned and is moving to Trump's political team.
Analitičari očekuju da bi Bijela kuća mogla biti oštrija prema Kongresu, pa je manje vjerovatno da će se stranke dogovoriti o novim zakonima.
Analysts expect that the White House could be tougher toward Congress, so it is less likely that the parties will agree on new laws.

title: Putin potvrdio pregovore Rusije, SAD-a i Ukrajine u Abu Dhabiju
Putin confirmed talks between Russia, the USA and Ukraine in Abu Dhabi
body: Ruski predsjednik Vladimir Putin potvrdio je da u utorak, 10. novembra, u Abu Dhabiju počinju pregovori Rusije, SAD-a i Ukrajine.
Russian President Vladimir Putin confirmed that talks between Russia, the USA and Ukraine begin in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday, 10 November.
To je rekao u petak na sastanku sa stalnim članovima Vijeća sigurnosti Rusije.
He said this on Friday at a meeting with the permanent members of Russia's Security Council.
Ruskom delegacijom vodi Vladimir Medinski, a Putin je zahvalio vlastima Emirata što Rusiji stalno pomažu.
The Russian delegation is led by Vladimir Medinsky, and Putin thanked the authorities of the Emirates for constantly helping Russia.
Prema Axiosu, američku delegaciju vode specijalni izaslanik Steve Witkoff i Jared Kushner.
According to Axios, the American delegation is led by special envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner.
Witkoff kaže da će se razgovarati o sigurnosnim garancijama, smirivanju situacije i humanitarnim pitanjima.
Witkoff says that they will talk about security guarantees, calming the situation and humanitarian issues.
Portparol Kremlja Dmitrij Peskov rekao je da Evropljani neće direktno učestvovati, jer će biti potrebni tek kada se bude govorilo o sistemu sigurnosti.
Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said that Europeans will not take part directly, because they will be needed only when a security system is discussed.
Ukrajinski ministar vanjskih poslova Andrij Sibiha poručio je da se nijedna odluka o Ukrajini neće donositi bez nje.
Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said that no decision about Ukraine will be made without it.
Kijev traži sigurnosne garancije, primirje u energetskom sektoru i razmjenu zarobljenika.
Kyiv wants security guarantees, a ceasefire in the energy sector and an exchange of prisoners.
Ovo je prvi susret u tri strane od februara, kada su prethodni razgovori održani u Abu Dhabiju.
This is the first three-sided meeting since February, when the previous talks were held in Abu Dhabi.
Kyrylo Budanov iz ukrajinske predsjedničke kancelarije rekao je da ne očekuje veliki iskorak, ali da je sam susret napredak.
Kyrylo Budanov from the Ukrainian presidential office said that he does not expect a big breakthrough, but that the meeting itself is progress.

title: Kod Bijele kuće uhapšen naoružani muškarac u ukradenom autu
Armed man in a stolen car arrested near the White House
body: Agenti Tajne službe u četvrtak navečer uhapsili su naoružanog muškarca u blizini Bijele kuće u Washingtonu.
Secret Service agents arrested an armed man near the White House in Washington on Thursday evening.
Vozilo su primijetili malo prije ponoći na ulici Constitution Avenue, nakon što je neko prijavio da se sumnjivo ponaša u parkiranom autu.
They noticed the vehicle shortly before midnight on Constitution Avenue, after someone reported that he was behaving suspiciously in a parked car.
Kasnije se pokazalo da je plavi Ford F-150 ukraden.
It later turned out that the blue Ford F-150 was stolen.
Kada je policajac pokucao na prozor i pitao ima li oružje, vozač je klimnuo glavom i prstima pokazao pištolj.
When the officer knocked on the window and asked whether he had a weapon, the driver nodded and showed a pistol with his fingers.
U autu su agenti našli pušku AR-15, automatski pištolj MAC-10 i pištolj Glock 43X, a prema ministarstvu i nekoliko desetina metaka.
In the car the agents found an AR-15 rifle, a MAC-10 submachine gun and a Glock 43X pistol, and according to the ministry also several dozen bullets.
Osumnjičeni je državljanin Venezuele, Ronny Yordrix Guanipa Chrinos.
The suspect is a citizen of Venezuela, Ronny Yordrix Guanipa Chrinos.
Prema ministarstvu domovinske sigurnosti, rekao je da mu glasovi u glavi naređuju da ubije predsjednika Trumpa, ali te riječi nisu u optužnici.
According to the Department of Homeland Security, he said that voices in his head order him to kill President Trump, but those words are not in the complaint.
Optužen je, između ostalog, za neovlašteno korištenje vozila i nošenje oružja bez dozvole.
He is charged, among other things, with unauthorized use of a vehicle and carrying weapons without a permit.
U petak se pojavio pred sudom i ostaje u pritvoru bez mogućnosti puštanja uz jamčevinu.
On Friday he appeared in court and remains in custody without the option of release on bail.
Ministarstvo tvrdi da je u zemlji ilegalno i da je u Teksas ušao u martu 2024.
The ministry claims that he is in the country illegally and that he entered Texas in March 2024.
Ministar Markwayne Mullin zahvalio je Tajnoj službi što je čovjeka uhapsila prije nego što je nekoga povrijedio.
Minister Markwayne Mullin thanked the Secret Service for arresting the man before he hurt anyone.

title: Izbori na Novom Zelandu: na snazi su vrlo stroga pravila
Elections in New Zealand: very strict rules are in force
body: Na Novom Zelandu su u subotu zatvarana birališta, a rezultati se tek čekaju.
In New Zealand polling stations were closing on Saturday, and the results are still awaited.
Glasanje prije izbornog dana počelo je 12 dana ranije, a prebrojavanje glasova počinje kada se birališta zatvore.
Voting before election day began 12 days earlier, and the counting of votes starts when the polling stations close.
Gradovi, uključujući glavni grad Wellington, bili su potpuno mirni, što je rijetkost u modernim demokratijama.
Cities, including the capital Wellington, were completely quiet, which is rare in modern democracies.
Od ponoći do zatvaranja birališta zabranjena je svaka kampanja, pa čak i medijsko izvještavanje o kandidatima.
From midnight until the polling stations close, any campaigning is banned, even media reporting about candidates.
Na 100 metara od biračkog mjesta ne smije se dijeliti ni hrana ni piće.
Within 100 metres of a polling place, even food and drink must not be handed out.
Profesor Andrew Geddis kaže da ta pravila potiču iz 19. stoljeća, kada su izbori bili bučna okupljanja uz mnogo alkohola.
Professor Andrew Geddis says that these rules come from the 19th century, when elections were noisy gatherings with a lot of alcohol.
Zemlja ima sistem u kojem svaki birač daje dva glasa, jedan za lokalnog kandidata i jedan za stranku, a stranka treba najmanje 5% da uđe u parlament.
The country has a system in which each voter gives two votes, one for a local candidate and one for a party, and a party needs at least 5% to enter parliament.
Trka je neizvjesna između premijera Christophera Luxona i bivšeg premijera Chrisa Hipkinsa.
The race is uncertain between Prime Minister Christopher Luxon and former Prime Minister Chris Hipkins.
Zbog tog sistema nijedna velika stranka ne može sama formirati vladu, pa manje stranke mogu biti odlučujuće.
Because of that system no big party can form a government alone, so smaller parties can be decisive.
Penzioner Doug Habgood, 72, nije mogao glasati putem interneta, pa je osam dana vozio bicikl oko 330 km do Canberre da bi glasao lično.
The pensioner Doug Habgood, 72, could not vote online, so he rode a bicycle for eight days about 330 km to Canberra to vote in person.

title: Škoda je druga po prodaji u Evropi i najbrže raste u VW grupi
Škoda is second in sales in Europe and grows fastest in the VW group
body: Češka marka Škoda u prvih devet mjeseci 2026. ima veću prodaju i veću dobit nego prošle godine.
The Czech brand Škoda has higher sales and higher profit in the first nine months of 2026 than last year.
U Evropi je registrovano skoro 667.000 njenih vozila, pa je ostala na drugom mjestu iza Volkswagena i ispred Toyote.
Almost 667,000 of its vehicles were registered in Europe, so it stayed in second place behind Volkswagen and ahead of Toyota.
Prodaja u Evropi porasla je za 7,5%, što je daleko najveći rast u cijeloj grupi Volkswagen.
Sales in Europe grew by 7.5%, which is by far the biggest growth in the whole Volkswagen group.
Prihod kompanije iznosi 23,13 milijardi eura, a to je 3,5% više nego lani.
The company's revenue is 23.13 billion euros, which is 3.5% more than last year.
Škoda je u svijetu isporučila 203.000 električnih i plug-in hibridnih automobila, skoro 35% više nego prije godinu.
Škoda delivered 203,000 electric and plug-in hybrid cars worldwide, almost 35% more than a year ago.
Modeli Elroq i Enyaq su treći i četvrti najprodavaniji električni automobili u Evropi.
The Elroq and Enyaq models are the third and fourth best-selling electric cars in Europe.
Najveće tržište je Njemačka, gdje je prodano više od 178.000 vozila.
The biggest market is Germany, where more than 178,000 vehicles were sold.
Najprodavaniji model u svijetu je Octavia, s 138.000 primjeraka.
The best-selling model in the world is the Octavia, with 138,000 units.
Novi modeli Epiq i Peaq imaju zajedno više od 82.000 narudžbi.
The new models Epiq and Peaq have more than 82,000 orders together.
U Bosni i Hercegovini Škoda već dugo vodi na tržištu novih automobila, a skoro svaki četvrti novi auto dolazi od njenih dilera.
In Bosnia and Herzegovina Škoda has led the new car market for a long time, and almost every fourth new car comes from its dealers.

title: Gitarista Tommy Emmanuel prvi put je svirao u Sarajevu
Guitarist Tommy Emmanuel played in Sarajevo for the first time
body: Australijski gitarista Tommy Emmanuel prvi put je održao koncert u Sarajevu.
The Australian guitarist Tommy Emmanuel held a concert in Sarajevo for the first time.
Nastupio je u Bosanskom kulturnom centru, kao dio turneje "Living in the Light".
He performed in the Bosnian Cultural Center, as part of the tour "Living in the Light".
Na sceni je bio sam, samo s gitarom, a publika ga je dočekala aplauzom.
He was alone on stage, only with a guitar, and the audience greeted him with applause.
Emmanuel svira prstima i istovremeno izvodi melodiju, bas i ritam, pa se čini da svira cijeli bend.
Emmanuel plays with his fingers and performs the melody, bass and rhythm at the same time, so it seems that a whole band is playing.
Između pjesama je mijenjao instrumente, a svirao je i sjedeći i stojeći.
Between songs he changed instruments, and he played both sitting and standing.
Izveo je pjesme s albuma "Living in the Light", koji je izašao u oktobru 2025. i prvi je njegov solo studijski album nakon deset godina.
He performed songs from the album "Living in the Light", which came out in October 2025 and is his first solo studio album in ten years.
Rekao je da je Sarajevo godinama na njegovoj listi, ali da mu niko nije htio organizirati koncert.
He said that Sarajevo had been on his list for years, but that nobody wanted to organize a concert for him.
Za umjetnika kao što je on, kaže, nema većeg uzbuđenja od sviranja pred novom publikom.
For an artist like him, he says, there is no greater thrill than playing for a new audience.
Prvu gitaru dobio je s četiri godine, a s šest je već nastupao s porodičnim bendom.
He got his first guitar at the age of four, and at six he was already performing with a family band.
Radio je s Ericom Claptonom, Stevieom Wonderom i Markom Knopflerom, a 2024. je osvojio nagradu Grammy.
He has worked with Eric Clapton, Stevie Wonder and Mark Knopfler, and in 2024 he won a Grammy award.
Dan ranije svirao je u Zagrebu.
The day before he played in Zagreb.

title: Dedić je spreman za Fulham, a Newcastle ga pušta reprezentaciji
Dedić is ready for Fulham, and Newcastle is releasing him to the national team
body: Incident s lukom i strijelom neće imati posljedice po bh. reprezentativca Amara Dedića.
The incident with the bow and arrow will have no consequences for the Bosnian international Amar Dedić.
Odbrambeni igrač Newcastlea zaustavljen je u četvrtak jer je nosio luk i strijelu, što se u Velikoj Britaniji smatra hladnim oružjem.
The Newcastle defender was stopped on Thursday because he was carrying a bow and arrow, which in Great Britain counts as a cold weapon.
Policija ga je zaustavila s šest vozila i oduzela mu opremu.
The police stopped him with six vehicles and took away his equipment.
Pošto je opremu koristio rekreativno, policija nije poduzela dalje korake.
Since he used the equipment for recreation, the police took no further steps.
Klub je potvrdio da incident neće uticati na njegov status u timu.
The club confirmed that the incident will not affect his status in the team.
Očekuje se da će Dedić biti dostupan za utakmicu protiv Fulhama u subotu.
Dedić is expected to be available for the match against Fulham on Saturday.
Newcastle je na društvenim mrežama potvrdio i da će on otputovati u reprezentaciju Bosne i Hercegovine.
Newcastle also confirmed on social media that he will travel to the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
To je dobra vijest za selektora Sergeja Barbareza, jer Dedić zbog povrede nije igrao u septembru i oktobru.
That is good news for the coach Sergej Barbarez, because Dedić did not play in September and October because of an injury.
Bosna i Hercegovina igra protiv Švedske 14. novembra u Ligi nacija.
Bosnia and Herzegovina plays against Sweden on 14 November in the Nations League.
Poslije toga, 17. novembra, u Zenici dočekuje Rumuniju.
After that, on 17 November, it hosts Romania in Zenica.

title: Stallone se sjetio kako mu je Pele slomio prst
Stallone remembered how Pelé broke his finger
body: Glumac Sylvester Stallone ponovo je ispričao kako mu je fudbalska legenda Pele slomio prst na snimanju filma.
The actor Sylvester Stallone told again how the football legend Pelé broke his finger while filming a movie.
Priču je ispričao u podcastu The Rest Is Entertainment.
He told the story in the podcast The Rest Is Entertainment.
Radi se o filmu Bijeg u pobjedu iz 1981. godine, u kojem zarobljenici u njemačkom logoru igraju utakmicu protiv njemačkog tima.
It is about the film Escape to Victory from 1981, in which prisoners in a German camp play a match against a German team.
Stallone je priznao da je isprva mislio da je fudbal lak, ali je brzo shvatio da nije u pravu.
Stallone admitted that at first he thought football was easy, but he quickly realised he was wrong.
Lopte iz tog doba opisao je kao male, teške i smeđe, skoro kao kuglu za kuglanje.
He described the balls of that time as small, heavy and brown, almost like a bowling ball.
Pele mu je ponudio da stane na gol, rekao mu je gdje će šutirati i upozorio ga da neće ni vidjeti loptu.
Pelé offered him to stand in goal, told him where he would shoot and warned him that he would not even see the ball.
Stallone mu je odgovorio: „Daj sve od sebe.“
Stallone answered him: "Give it everything."
Kada je Pele šutnuo, glumac je podigao ruke, a lopta je probila staru mrežu i razbila prozore na barakama iza nje.
When Pelé kicked, the actor raised his hands, and the ball broke through the old net and smashed the windows of the barracks behind it.
Pele se smatra jednim od najboljih fudbalera svih vremena.
Pelé is considered one of the best footballers of all time.
U karijeri je dao više od 1.000 golova, a umro je 29. decembra 2022. u 82. godini.
In his career he scored more than 1,000 goals, and he died on 29 December 2022 at the age of 82.

title: Brodovi mailom traže dozvolu od Huta za Crveno more
Ships ask the Houthis for permission by email to cross the Red Sea
body: Američki list Wall Street Journal istražio je kako brodovi traže siguran prolaz kroz Crveno more od Huta.
The American paper Wall Street Journal investigated how ships ask the Houthis for safe passage through the Red Sea.
Huti od početka 2024. godine imaju ured koji prima zahtjeve brodova i objavljuje sankcije koje oni uvode.
Since the beginning of 2024 the Houthis have had an office that receives ships' requests and publishes the sanctions they impose.
Kapetani im pišu običnim e-mailom.
Captains write to them by ordinary email.
Brodovi koji nisu povezani sa SAD-om, Velikom Britanijom ili Izraelom formalno ne moraju kontaktirati taj ured.
Ships that are not linked to the USA, Great Britain or Israel do not formally have to contact that office.
Ipak, neki su počeli slati upite nakon što su Huti u julu proglasili pomorsku blokadu Saudijske Arabije.
Even so, some started sending inquiries after the Houthis declared a naval blockade of Saudi Arabia in July.
Jedan kapetan je 16. augusta napisao da su vlasnik, operater i posada kineski, te je tražio siguran prolaz.
On 16 August one captain wrote that the owner, operator and crew are Chinese, and he asked for safe passage.
Kineski kontejnerski brod dobio je 7. septembra dozvolu koja je važila sedam dana.
A Chinese container ship received a permit on 7 September that was valid for seven days.
Huti su savjetovali da ostane uključen sistem za praćenje i da brod izbjegava vojna plovila.
The Houthis advised that the tracking system stay on and that the ship avoid military vessels.
Međunarodne vlasti savjetuju brodarima da ne komuniciraju s tim uredom, a SAD smatra Hute terorističkom organizacijom.
International authorities advise shippers not to communicate with that office, and the USA considers the Houthis a terrorist organisation.
Prema listu, Huti su u septembru zauzeli važno ostrvo u moreuzu i jedan obalni grad.
According to the paper, in September the Houthis took an important island in the strait and a coastal city.
Kroz taj moreuz prolazi 10 do 12 posto pomorskog transporta nafte.
Between 10 and 12 percent of the sea transport of oil passes through that strait.

title: Fabrika aluminija u Vlasenici mogla bi stati do kraja godine
The aluminium factory in Vlasenica could stop by the end of the year
body: Upravni odbor kompanije Alpro iz Vlasenice predložio je dioničarima da do kraja godine zaustave proizvodnju aluminijskih profila.
The board of the company Alpro from Vlasenica has proposed to shareholders that they stop the production of aluminium profiles by the end of the year.
Proizvodnja bi stala 31. decembra, a o prijedlogu se odlučuje 24. novembra.
Production would stop on 31 December, and the proposal will be decided on 24 November.
Ako tada ne bude kvoruma, nova sjednica s istim dnevnim redom održat će se sljedećeg dana.
If there is no quorum then, a new session with the same agenda will be held the next day.
Alpro je osnovan 1977. godine, a većinski vlasnik je od privatizacije 2004. firma Alumil YU Industry iz Srbije.
Alpro was founded in 1977, and since the privatisation in 2004 the majority owner has been the firm Alumil YU Industry from Serbia.
Ona ima 61,37 posto dionica, pa odluka praktično zavisi od nje.
It has 61.37 percent of the shares, so the decision practically depends on it.
Kompanija je 2023. izgubila oko 2,76 miliona KM, 2024. oko 1,55 miliona, a 2025. oko 1,71 miliona KM.
In 2023 the company lost about 2.76 million KM, in 2024 about 1.55 million, and in 2025 about 1.71 million KM.
To je ukupno oko šest miliona KM u tri godine.
That is about six million KM in total in three years.
Prihodi od prodaje porasli su sa 24,63 na 26,17 miliona KM, a broj zaposlenih sa 116 na 139.
Sales revenue rose from 24.63 to 26.17 million KM, and the number of employees from 116 to 139.
Zaustavljanje proizvodnje ne znači da će firma biti zatvorena, jer na dnevnom redu nema stečaja ni likvidacije.
Stopping production does not mean the firm will be closed, because there is no bankruptcy or liquidation on the agenda.
Nije objavljeno ni šta će biti s radnicima.
It has not been announced what will happen to the workers either.

title: Eisenkot kaže da će uskoro dobiti mandat za vladu
Eisenkot says he will soon get the mandate to form a government
body: Izraelski političar Gadi Eisenkot rekao je u petak da su pregovori o novoj vladi mnogo napredovali.
Israeli politician Gadi Eisenkot said on Friday that the talks about a new government have moved forward a lot.
Očekuje da će početkom sljedeće sedmice dobiti mandat za formiranje vlade.
He expects to receive the mandate to form a government at the start of next week.
Svoju poruku objavio je na mreži X, dan nakon što je predsjednik Isaac Herzog završio razgovore sa strankama u Knesetu.
He posted his message on the network X, a day after President Isaac Herzog finished talks with the parties in the Knesset.
Herzog je rekao da stranke sa 67 poslanika preporučuju Eisenkota, a stranke sa 46 poslanika Benjamina Netanyahua.
Herzog said that parties with 67 MPs recommend Eisenkot, and parties with 46 MPs recommend Benjamin Netanyahu.
Eisenkot tvrdi da 74 od 120 članova Knesta nemaju povjerenje u Netanyahua.
Eisenkot claims that 74 of the 120 members of the Knesset do not trust Netanyahu.
Herzog će u nedjelju objaviti ko dobija mandat i upozorio je da rezultati samo na prvi pogled izgledaju jasni.
Herzog will announce on Sunday who gets the mandate, and he warned that the results only look clear at first glance.
Eisenkot smatra da premijer bez većine ne bi smio kontrolisati sigurnosni sistem ni jedan dan.
Eisenkot thinks that a prime minister without a majority should not control the security system even for one day.
Za ulazak u vladu postavio je četiri uslova.
He has set four conditions for joining the government.
Izrael mora biti priznat kao jevrejska i demokratska država, a svi moraju imati vojnu ili civilnu službu.
Israel must be recognised as a Jewish and democratic state, and everyone must do military or civil service.
Osim toga, treba prihvatiti vrijednosti Deklaracije nezavisnosti i priznati Hamas kao terorističku organizaciju.
In addition, the values of the Declaration of Independence must be accepted and Hamas recognised as a terrorist organisation.
Eisenkot je rekao da će historija pamtiti one koji bez dobrog razloga blokiraju formiranje vlade.
Eisenkot said that history will remember those who block the forming of the government without a good reason.

title: Džeko otkrio čega se boji i šta bi jeo cijeli život
Džeko revealed what he fears and what he would eat all his life
body: Edin Džeko, bivši kapiten reprezentacije Bosne i Hercegovine, odgovarao je na brza pitanja o privatnom životu.
Edin Džeko, former captain of the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team, answered quick questions about his private life.
Snimak je objavio zvanični Instagram profil Bundeslige.
The recording was posted by the official Instagram profile of the Bundesliga.
Za najpoznatijeg čovjeka iz rodnog Sarajeva odmah je rekao Dinu Merlina.
As the most famous person from his native Sarajevo he immediately named Dino Merlin.
Najdraži mjesec mu je mart, jer tada ima rođendan.
His favourite month is March, because his birthday is then.
Najprecjenjenijom bojom smatra svijetloplavu.
He thinks light blue is the most underrated colour.
Kada bi cijeli život mogao jesti samo jedno, to bi bilo jelo njegove majke, posebno sarma.
If he could eat only one thing all his life, it would be his mother's cooking, especially sarma.
Najljepši miris na svijetu je, kako kaže, miris pobjede poslije utakmice.
The best smell in the world is, as he says, the smell of victory after a match.
Da nije fudbaler, volio bi biti stručnjak za Formulu 1.
If he were not a footballer, he would like to be an expert on Formula 1.
Rekao je da je najviše ponosan na male dobre stvari koje radi za druge, o kojima nikada javno ne priča.
He said he is most proud of the small good things he does for others, which he never talks about in public.
Priznao je i da se boji velikih visina.
He also admitted that he is afraid of great heights.
Zato nikada ne bi skočio padobranom iz aviona ni bungee skok.
That is why he would never jump from a plane with a parachute or do a bungee jump.

title: Teška nesreća na autoputu A1 kod Podlugova
Serious accident on the A1 motorway near Podlugovi
body: Na autoputu A1 kod Podlugova dogodila se teška saobraćajna nesreća.
A serious traffic accident happened on the A1 motorway near Podlugovi.
Nesreća je bila oko 17 sati u smjeru od Sarajeva prema Zenici.
The accident was at around 17:00 in the direction from Sarajevo towards Zenica.
Sudarila su se dva putnička vozila.
Two passenger cars collided.
Na licu mjesta je velika materijalna šteta, a dijelovi vozila rasuti su po cijeloj kolovoznoj traci.
At the scene there is a lot of material damage, and parts of the vehicles are scattered across the whole lane.
U vrijeme objave teksta nije bilo poznato da li je neko povrijeđen.
At the time the text was published it was not known whether anyone was injured.
Policija još nije stigla na mjesto nesreće.
The police had not yet arrived at the scene of the accident.
Saobraćaj na tom dijelu puta je otežan.
Traffic on that part of the road is difficult.
Očekuje se da će uskoro biti potpuno zaustavljen.
It is expected that it will soon be completely stopped.
Vozačima se savjetuje da budu dodatno oprezni.
Drivers are advised to be extra careful.

title: Ljudi sa srčanim problemima rjeđe jedu cijelo voće
People with heart problems eat whole fruit less often
body: Novo istraživanje pokazuje da odrasli s visokim pritiskom, visokim holesterolom ili srčanim bolestima rjeđe jedu cijelo voće.
New research shows that adults with high blood pressure, high cholesterol or heart disease eat whole fruit less often.
Studiju su radili istraživači s Univerziteta Sjeverne Dakote i jednog američkog centra za istraživanje ishrane.
The study was done by researchers from the University of North Dakota and an American nutrition research centre.
Objavljena je u časopisu Current Developments in Nutrition.
It was published in the journal Current Developments in Nutrition.
Analizirali su podatke više od 371.000 Amerikanaca iz telefonske zdravstvene ankete iz 2019. godine.
